What Changed in London’s Soundscape?

Dominant sound source of each street in central London, 2005-2015 versus 2016-2026, as tagged on Flickr photos. The map is coloured by the 2016-2026 dominant sound source; move the cursor over a street to see how its share of sound tags changed since 2005-2015.

Loading streets

Method after Aiello, Schifanella, Quercia and Aletta (2016) Chatty Maps, Royal Society Open Science 3:150690. Flickr photos tagged with the Freesound derived sound dictionary; street network © OpenStreetMap contributors (7 November 2026). Colour is the sound category with the highest z score on streets with at least 5 sound tags. #30DayMapChallenge Day 11: Sound.
